title.full: GPFirst: paying less at the emergency department

summary.text: Bring your doctor's original GPFirst form to a partner hospital's A&E the same day.

details.heading: Which hospitals
details.body: Changi General, Khoo Teck Puat, National University (adult A&E only), Ng Teng Fong, Sengkang General, Singapore General and Tan Tock Seng hospitals, and the Alexandra Hospital Urgent Care Centre.

details.heading: Who can use it
details.body: Everyone living in Singapore, including permanent residents and foreigners.

steps.name: Get the form from your doctor
steps.text: Only participating GP clinics near the partner hospitals give a GPFirst referral form.

steps.name: Check date, time, stamp
steps.text: The form must show the referral date, the referral time and the clinic's stamp.

steps.name: Go to A&E the same day
steps.text: Go the same day. If the form was given between 10pm and midnight, you can go until 2am.

steps.name: Show the form and your NRIC
steps.text: At registration, show the original, fully completed form together with your NRIC.

steps.name: Extra tests cost extra
steps.text: Special tests or non-standard medicines at A&E are charged separately.

sources.page_title: Is the GPFirst programme applicable at all EDs?

quotes.text: This programme is available at the participating GP clinics within the regions of the above-mentioned participating hospitals.

For GPFirst Programme to be valid, the original referral form must be fully completed and produced together with the NRIC/passport/work permit/foreigner pass, at the point of registration at the respective hospital’s ED or UCC.
The referral date, referral time and clinic stamp must be clearly indicated on the original GPFirst Referral Form.
Patients’ visit to the ED/UCC must be within the same day of the GP's referral or up to 0200hrs of the following day if the form is issued close to midnight (between 10pm to 12am).
Specialised investigations required and/or non-standard medications prescribed at participating hospitals’ ED or UCC will be separately charged

This programme is only applicable at the Changi General Hospital (CGH), Khoo Teck Puat Hospital (KTPH), National University Hospital (NUH) (Adult ED only), Ng Teng Fong General Hospital (NTFGH), Sengkang General Hospital (SKH), Singapore General Hospital (SGH), Tan Tock Seng Hospital (TTSH) Emergency Departments (ED) or Alexandra Hospital Urgent Care Centre (AH UCC).
The GPFirst programme is open to all residents living in Singapore, including PRs and foreigners.
